name: Female Attendant
material: Gray earthenware with slip and polychrome pigments
summary: Gray earthenware with slip and polychrome pigments。57.2 × 18 × 14.8 cm (22 1/2 × 7 1/16 × 5 13/16 in.)。Potter Palmer Collection, gift of Mrs. Potter Palmer
history: This figure wears the narrow, calf-length robe distinctive of servants. Her facial features, characteristically masklike and serene, are framed by long hair, which is parted and tied in a bun at the nape of her neck. Her cupped hands may originally have held a staff.
